original_title: Champion modder ports the OG 'Father' Nier back into the PC remaster, original voiceovers and all
summary_en: A passionate modder has successfully brought the original 'Father' Nier back to the 2022 PC remaster of Nier Replicant, complete with his iconic voiceovers. This beloved character, absent from the Western release of the original game, is now playable again.
ai_analysis: This mod is a testament to the enduring appeal of the original Nier Gestalt and the dedication of its fanbase, offering a compelling 'what if' scenario for players who never experienced Papa Nier.

en.title: OG 'Father' Nier Returns to PC Remaster Thanks to Dedicated Modder
en.summary: A passionate modder has successfully brought the original 'Father' Nier back to the 2022 PC remaster of Nier Replicant, complete with his iconic voiceovers. This beloved character, absent from the Western release of the original game, is now playable again.
en.body:
For years, fans of the cult classic **Nier** have debated which version of the protagonist truly captured the game's melancholic spirit. The 2010 original offered two distinct protagonists: the younger, anime-esque 'Brother' Nier in **Nier Replicant** (primarily released in Japan) and the grizzled, middle-aged 'Father' Nier in **Nier Gestalt** (the version most of the West received). While the 2022 remaster, **Nier Replicant ver.1.22474487139…**, finally brought Brother Nier to a global audience on PC, many veteran players longed for the return of the older, more world-weary Father Nier.

Now, thanks to the incredible efforts of modder Elevna, that wish has become a reality. Elevna's 'Gestalt ver.1.22474487139…' mod meticulously replaces the young protagonist of the remaster with the original Father Nier model. But the transformation doesn't stop at visuals; the mod also painstakingly restores the original voice acting from **Nier Gestalt**, ensuring a fully authentic experience. This project breathes new life into the remaster, allowing players to experience the narrative through the eyes of the character many grew to love first, a father figure driven by a desperate love for his daughter.

## The Legacy of Father Nier

The decision to create two versions of **Nier** was a strategic move by Square Enix during the Xbox 360 era, aiming to appeal to Western audiences with a more traditionally masculine hero. While Brother Nier aligns with Yoko Taro's original artistic vision, Father Nier’s more mature portrayal resonated deeply with many players. His paternal role in the post-apocalyptic setting, fighting to protect his daughter Yonah, provided a powerful emotional anchor. Despite the critical acclaim **Nier Automata** eventually brought to the series, the original **Nier** often struggled to find its footing with initial reviews, a fate many believe was partly due to its protagonist not connecting with a broader Western audience at the time. The remaster's success, however, vindicated the original's profound storytelling and unique atmosphere.

## A Fan-Driven Triumph

The release of this mod has been met with widespread enthusiasm from the **Nier** community. It addresses a long-standing desire among players who cherished the original **Nier Gestalt** and felt its absence in the **Nier Replicant** remaster. The prospect of an official 'Father Nier' DLC was once rumored but never materialized, making Elevna's mod an essential download for those seeking the complete **Nier** experience. By carefully porting the original model and audio files, the mod delivers a high-quality, faithful recreation that honors the game's legacy and the passionate fan base that continues to keep it alive.

What's Next

While there are no official announcements regarding further content for **Nier Replicant ver.1.22474487139…**, the modding community's dedication ensures that players can continue to explore and reimagine their favorite games. Fans eagerly await any future developments from developer Yoko Taro and his team, who are known for their unique and unforgettable storytelling.

content_raw: Modder Elevna on the Nier Replicant Nexus has made my day with the full release of Nier Gestalt ver.1.22474487139… , a project that replaces the young protagonist of the cult classic's 2022 remaster with his grizzled, older counterpart from the 2010 original. Let's back up: In Yoko Taro's vision for Nier, the titular protagonist (whose name you're allowed to change for some reason) was a waifish anime twink who kinda looks like Raiden from Metal Gear. This was during peak Xbox 360, the piss filter era , so Square Enix executives wanted a hero with a little more Unreal Engine 3 beefy masculinity to appeal to the west. The compromise: Japan got two versions of Nier. Replicant on the PS3 boasted Yoko Taro's preferred "Brother" Nier, so named because he's siblings with fellow main character Yonah. The Xbox 360's Nier Gestalt featured "Father" Nier, who was aged up to his 40s, put on a powerlifting program, and made to be Yonah's dad. In the west, we basically only got Nier Gestalt no matter the console version. Fast forward to 2022, and Nier gets a remaster because everybody took another look after the explosive success of Nier Automata and realized the original was always good⁠—I liked Nier before it was cool, and I'm not bitter about all those 6/10s it got. The cheekily named Nier Replicant ver.1.22474487139… brought Brother Nier to the west for the first time, giving us oldheads something to get excited about (aside from finally having a PC version). Here's the thing, though: Yoko Taro, I love you and your eccentric auteur purity, but just this once, the shadowy cabal of risk-averse, art-hating, shareholder-worshipping executives was right . Father Nier is the man . Grizzled dads protecting their kids in the post apocalypse is played out, sure, but Father Nier is one of the high water marks of the form⁠—not the least because he's kind of an asshole who sucks and makes everything worse. Nier shows a world well past its sell-by date, and while both Brother and Father Nier are men possessed by ungovernable rage, Papa Nier cuts it with this sense of mournful weariness that just ties a nice bow on the tragedy of it all. It's mostly sold by a career-best performance from prolific voice actor Jamieson Price , who I only just realized was also part of one of my favorite dialogue exchanges in any RPG . There were rumblings Square Enix might do an official Father Nier DLC, but it never panned out. Cue Elevna's Gestalt mod, which offers a full, luxury Papa Nier experience in 2026. The original model is back and touched up, great, but Elevna also dug all of the audio files for Price's voiceover out of the original and ported them here, making the mod essential. That would have been enough for me, but Elevna's attention to detail is truly impressive.
